name: quest-book
title: Quest Book
author: Maksym Prymierov
description: An in-game story quest book that guides you from the crash landing to the edge of the solar system. Supports vanilla, Space Age, Krastorio 2, Muluna, Moshine, Cerys and Maraxsis; chapters and quests for missing mods or content are omitted or skipped automatically, and the numbering adapts to whatever is installed.
